definitions.granularity: chunk-level; one result is one chunks row, joined to documents
definitions.metric: cosine distance (<=>); lower is better; distance is raw pgvector output
definitions.exact_baseline: same DENSE_SEARCH_SQL, same query vector, same distance, same Top-K and granularity, with transaction-local enable_indexscan=off, enable_bitmapscan=off, enable_indexonlyscan=off and enable_seqscan=on; verified to produce Seq Scan on chunks
definitions.ann_recall: Recall@K of the ANN chunk keys against the exact cosine Top-K keys; denominator is the exact result count
definitions.semantic_recall: doc-level Recall@K of the returned unique doc_ids against relevant_doc_ids; this is labelled retrieval quality, not ANN fidelity
definitions.latency_query_ms: execute + fetch around the retrieval SELECT only
definitions.latency_db_ms: pool borrow + transaction + planner/GUC setup + execute + fetch
definitions.warmup: model load and first encode are measured separately and excluded; exact reference is untimed; each config gets untimed passes before timed passes
definitions.percentile: nearest rank: ceil(p/100 * n), clamped to [1, n]
